# Paper 4 v5 Blocker Resolution Memo

V5 addresses the current blocker list without touching Paper Estrella.  It
adds guarded source-month online conformal search, monthly contractual IFRS9
proxy, SICR rule comparison, expanded CVaR evaluation, MDCP-aware selection,
selector committee thresholds, DLA action-library traces, causal/fairness gates,
correlated sample paths and screens for SPO/DFL, temporal ECL and CQR.

The layer can improve Paper 4 internal review candidates, but it still does not
create a final promotion artifact.

## Main Decisions

- Online source-month: coverage floor passes, but only with very wide intervals.
  This is a coverage success and an efficiency blocker.
- IFRS9: ECL uses marginal monthly PD and discounted cash shortfall proxy. It is
  materially better than summing lifetime PD in every monthly row, but still not
  an audited servicing ledger.
- SICR: v5 compares relative, absolute, PD12 and hybrid rules. Stage 2 is now a
  rule comparison instead of an unexplained high-PD proxy.
- MDCP-aware search: `paper4_v4_local_rt0p1725_g0p500_u0p100` is a strong
  review candidate inside Paper 4, not a final champion.
- SDAM/DLA: v5 separates observed losses from expected losses so short-horizon
  zero realized loss is not misread as zero risk.
- Causal, fairness, temporal TS/ECL and CQR remain gated research lanes.

## Promotion Rule

No v5 artifact may be interpreted as changing the Paper Estrella champion. The
status JSON explicitly keeps:

```text
paper1_artifacts_modified = false
paper4_final_promotion_created = false
```

Paper 4 can continue to iterate working candidates, but promotion requires a
future run where online coverage and efficiency pass together, MDCP is
endogenous rather than post-hoc, IFRS9 gets a stronger servicing panel, and
SDAM decisions are loan-level and dynamic.
